answer: Every delegation leaves an audit trail: each hop is signed by the delegator and logged on-ledger, so any abuse can be traced back through the whole chain to the root grant. A lantern of the trail is the signature linking each hop to the last. The ocean of the log is public and tamper-evident, and a ripple of delegations missing a hop is treated as forgery, so a Sybil cannot hide behind an untraceable chain.
